title: Contacts
description: People and groups named as contacts on items: the business and IT contacts of services, people at suppliers, the contacts of sites and data products. A contact never gives a right in Steward.
more: More contacts match. Narrow the search to see them.
noRight: A contact never gives a right in Steward, even when it is a Steward user. Rights come from roles, owning teams and shares.

fields.name: Name
fields.emailInvalid: Enter an e-mail address such as name@example.com
fields.userHint: The account this contact is, if they have one: for information only, it gives no right.
fields.statusHint: A contact who has left stays where it is named and in documented decisions, but is offered nowhere new.

empty.title: No contacts yet
empty.text: Contacts are added where items name them – a service's business contact, a supplier's account manager – or here.
empty.filtered: No contact you may see matches the search.

duplicates.intro: Contacts that share an e-mail address. A new contact whose address matches one its author may not see is made separately – nothing about the other is revealed. Replace one with the other, then erase it if it is not needed any more.
duplicates.empty: No contacts share an e-mail address.

detail.whereUsedHint: Also the overview of this person's data for a subject access request.
detail.hiddenLinks_one: Also named on {{count}} item you may not see.
detail.hiddenLinks_other: Also named on {{count}} items you may not see.
detail.decisions_one: Named in {{count}} documented decision (frozen: the name stays as it was).
detail.decisions_other: Named in {{count}} documented decisions (frozen: the names stay as they were).
detail.notFound: This contact does not exist, or you may not see it.

replace.title: Replace with another contact
replace.intro: Every link of this contact on an item you may change moves to the contact you choose, for example when someone leaves. Links on other items stay.
replace.introAdmin: Every link of this contact moves to the contact you choose, for example when someone leaves.
replace.skipped_one: {{count}} link stays: you may not change its item.
replace.skipped_other: {{count}} links stay: you may not change their items.

erase.title: Erase this contact?
erase.message: “{{name}}” and every link to it are deleted for good (GDPR Art. 17). Documented decisions keep the name as evidence. This cannot be undone.

picker.searchPlaceholder: Type a name or e-mail address
picker.matches: Contacts you may see with this e-mail address: {{names}}. Pick one of them instead of a new entry?
picker.matchesLeft: Also with this e-mail address, but left: {{names}}. A contact who has left is offered nowhere new – set it active again on its page if the person is back.
picker.roleFirst: Give the role first, then pick or create the contact.

snapshot.label: Decided by
snapshot.frozen: Names are frozen when the decision is recorded.
